title: Room Code Mystery
summary: Solve a three-round browser mystery with 4–8 friends and one shared room code.
user: Remote friend groups who want a warm, low-stakes 20-minute social deduction game with a room code, no pack purchase, and no AI-generated judgments.
smallest_useful_product: A 4–8 player browser mystery told in three timed evidence rounds. Each player receives different visual clues; the group submits one accusation before a compact reveal. One host shares a code, remote players use personal views.
monetization: Disabled for this release by the polish-1 controller instruction: both authored cases are free, and no paid promise is shown until product-scoped Sociobot checkout exists.
constraints: Original cases and art; no retained user accusations; no public matchmaking, voice, video, permanent accounts, or automated judging.
